boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Hendrix College
boards.description: Ten currently verifiable, under-21-safe food stops in Conway with late or round-the-clock service.

cards.title: Taco Bell on Prince Street
cards.subtitle: 2715 Prince Street, Conway
cards.notes: Use the drive-thru when dining room service has ended; the official location page lists the drive-thru as open 24 hours every day.
cards.short_summary: A Prince Street drive-thru with round-the-clock listed availability.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists the drive-thru at 2715 Prince Street as open 24 hours daily.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists drive-thru hours as open 24 hours Sunday through Saturday; dine-in hours are more limited.

cards.title: Taco Bell on East Oak
cards.subtitle: 205 E Oak Street, Conway
cards.notes: Plan for drive-thru service after the dining room closes; the location’s official hours show the drive-thru open 24 hours daily.
cards.short_summary: An East Oak option whose listed drive-thru schedule runs around the clock.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists the drive-thru at 205 E Oak Street as open 24 hours every day.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell — 205 E Oak Street, Conway
cards.access_notes: Official page lists drive-thru hours as 12:00 AM–12:00 AM every day; dine-in hours are separately limited.

cards.title: Taco Bell on Dave Ward Drive
cards.subtitle: 2195 Dave Ward Drive, Conway
cards.notes: Check the day before heading out: official drive-thru hours extend to 4 AM most nights and 5 AM on Friday and Saturday.
cards.short_summary: A Dave Ward drive-thru with listed service into the early morning.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists drive-thru service until 4 AM Sunday–Thursday and 5 AM Friday–Saturday at this location.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell — 2195 Dave Ward Drive, Conway
cards.access_notes: Official drive-thru hours: until 4 AM Sunday–Thursday and 5 AM Friday–Saturday.

cards.title: Whataburger on East Oak
cards.subtitle: 813 E Oak Street, Conway
cards.notes: This location lists dine-in and drive-thru service 24 hours daily, giving a clearly documented all-night food option on East Oak.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour dine-in and drive-thru restaurant on East Oak.
cards.evidence_claim: Whataburger #1518 lists its dine-in and drive-thru service as 24 hours every day.
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists dine-in and drive-thru as 24 hours Monday through Sunday.

cards.title: Denny’s on Crain Drive
cards.subtitle: 900 Crain Drive, Conway
cards.notes: Choose this diner when you need a sit-down option late; its official Conway page lists the restaurant as open 24 hours every day.
cards.short_summary: A Conway diner with officially listed 24-hour restaurant service.
cards.evidence_claim: Denny’s lists its 900 Crain Drive Conway restaurant as open 24 hours daily.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists restaurant hours as open 24 hours Sunday through Saturday.

cards.title: Wendy’s on Oak Street
cards.subtitle: 311 Oak Street, Conway
cards.notes: Use either the restaurant or drive-thru before midnight; the official location page lists both services until 12 AM every day.
cards.short_summary: An Oak Street restaurant and drive-thru open through midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy’s lists restaurant and drive-thru hours of 7 AM–12 AM daily at 311 Oak Street.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists restaurant and drive-thru hours as 7 AM–12 AM Monday through Sunday.

cards.title: Wendy’s on Highway 64 West
cards.subtitle: 1200 Highway 64 West, Conway
cards.notes: Confirm your route, then use the listed restaurant or drive-thru service through midnight; both have the same daily posted closing time.
cards.short_summary: A Highway 64 West option with restaurant and drive-thru hours through midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy’s lists restaurant and drive-thru hours of 7 AM–12 AM daily at 1200 Highway 64 West.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists restaurant and drive-thru hours as 7 AM–12 AM Monday through Sunday.

cards.title: Wendy’s on Dave Ward Drive
cards.subtitle: 3750 Dave Ward Drive, Conway
cards.notes: For a midnight closing-time option on Dave Ward, use the restaurant or drive-thru; the location page posts both services until 12 AM daily.
cards.short_summary: A Dave Ward restaurant and drive-thru with midnight listed closing.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy’s lists restaurant and drive-thru hours of 7 AM–12 AM daily at 3750 Dave Ward Drive.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists restaurant and drive-thru hours as 7 AM–12 AM Monday through Sunday.

cards.title: Domino’s on East German Lane
cards.subtitle: 1075 East German Lane, Conway
cards.notes: Use the store’s current-hours display before placing a carryout or delivery order; its official location page currently shows service until midnight.
cards.short_summary: A pizza carryout and delivery location currently listed through midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: Domino’s official location page for 1075 East German Lane currently lists the store open until 12 AM.
cards.access_notes: Official location page currently displays “Today Until 12:00 AM”; it advises customers to check its Hours section for up-to-date store hours.

cards.title: Pizza Hut on East Oak
cards.subtitle: 1825 E Oak Street, Conway
cards.notes: Order carryout or delivery from this East Oak location; the official page posts midnight closing Sunday through Thursday and 1 AM Friday and Saturday.
cards.short_summary: An East Oak pizza stop with official late-week hours extending to 1 AM.
cards.evidence_claim: Pizza Hut lists hours until midnight Sunday–Thursday and until 1 AM Friday–Saturday at 1825 E Oak Street.
cards.source_title: Pizza Hut — 1825 E Oak Street, Conway
cards.access_notes: Official restaurant-hours table lists 9 AM–12 AM Sunday–Thursday and 9 AM–1 AM Friday–Saturday.
